To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of SiC cascoded JFETs under UIS is significantly reduced compared to SiC stand-alone JFETs due to gate leakage current.
SiC JFets have a higher avalanche energy than Si IGBTs, but their avalanche energy is reduced by gate leakage current.
the SiC JFETS avalanche characteristics and UIS performance are strongly influenced by the JFET peak avalanche current and gate resistance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the UIS performance and ruggedness under repetitive and single UIS of stand-alone and SiC cascode devices.
the performance and ruggedness assessment of stand-alone and SiC cascode devices under single and repetitive UIS.
the evaluation of the performance and ruggedness characteristics of stand-alone and SiC JFETS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SiC cascode devices are more robust under repetitive UIS than stand-alone devices, however, they are not more rugged under single UIS.
the performance of SiC JFETS under repetitive UIS is significantly affected by the avalanche current, gate leakage current, gate resistance and temperature.

the SiC JFETS have a very good UIS performance and that the cascode configuration does not improve the UIS performance of the stand-alone JFETs, on the contrary, the cascode configuration reduces the UIS performance of stand-alone SiC devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SiC JFETS can be used for high power applications with the proper design and selection of the JFETS.
the SiC cascode devices are not recommended for repetitive UIS conditions.
the SiC JFETS are more rugged than SiC MOSFETs and Si IGBTs under repetitive UIS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gate resistance is a key factor in the design of cascode SiC power devices.
the SiC JFets can operate under repetitive UIS, and the gate current plays a key role on their performance.
the SiC JFETS are more rugged under repetitive UIS when the gate resistance is minimized.
